title: Chapter 65 Power Revival
content:
Chapter 65 Power Revival

Then, the entire Wanling Realm suddenly seemed to calm down.

But Lu Daosheng clearly understood that this was just the calm before the storm.

However, during this period of time, the deserted city should indeed settle down.

Lu Daosheng looked at a certain place in the Wanling Realm with a calm expression.

And at this moment, Ao Qing came back.

In the hall.

A human man threw Ao Qing to the ground.

"Ouch, brother, be gentle!"

Ao Qing got up from the ground and saw Lu Daosheng, and his face was immediately ashamed.

"Master, I, I failed."

Thinking of his solemn promise at the beginning, he felt a burning pain on his face, even if he was thick-skinned.

However, Lu Daosheng ignored Ao Qing, but said to the man next to Ao Qing: "Kong, you have worked hard."

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at him with a trace of relief.

Kong.

It was the little beggar that Lu Daosheng met in the simple alley in the Tianxuan world.

Then he was thrown into the palm world by Lu Daosheng to practice.

Even Lu Daosheng didn't expect that this little guy actually passed the hell secret realm and got the death mark from it.

This guy's willpower is really terrifying.

Here Lu Daosheng has to brag about himself, his vision is really good.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Kong quickly knelt on one knee and said respectfully: "I will do whatever you want."

Then, at Lu Daosheng's signal, Kong retreated.

At this time, Ao Qing thought that Lu Daosheng was too lazy to pay attention to him because he was not doing a good job, and even wanted to abandon him.

Suddenly, Ao Qing was ashamed and his head drooped as if he was going to drill into the ground.

Seeing Ao Qing like this, Lu Daosheng said, "Ao Qing."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's call, Ao Qing hurriedly said, "Master, I am not doing a good job, and I am willing to be punished!"

Just don't drive him away.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

"I have said before that the Wasteland City is not worse than the Dragon Clan."

"In fact, I knew you would fail a long time ago, and if you choose to stay in the Dragon Clan, I will not interfere too much, but since you choose the Wasteland City, you must be prepared."

Hearing this, Ao Qing's pupils shrank, and then his eyes turned red.

"Master,"

At this time, Ao Qing thought of something, and then hesitated and said, "Master, the Dragon Clan,"

Before he finished speaking, Lu Daosheng raised his hand to interrupt.

"I don't care about the Dragon Clan's affairs. You can decide this matter by yourself."

The future of the Dragon Clan will be decided by Ao Qing, not by Lu Daosheng.

Immediately, Ao Qing understood what Lu Daosheng meant.

"Master, Ao Qing knows."

"Go down and accompany Xiaoxue."

"Yes, Master."

Ao Qing left immediately.

At the original place, Lu Daosheng sighed slightly and looked into the distance.

And the deserted city also fell into a period of peace.

Cultivation does not take time, and soon, 30,000 years have passed.

There is no doubt that in 30,000 years, the deserted city has become the strongest force in the world of all spirits.

And the status of the human race in the world of all spirits seems to have returned to the past.

In the deserted city.

A breath of the king of heaven rose from somewhere.

For all this, everyone in the deserted city glanced at it lightly, and then did what they had to do.

And in the world of all spirits, all living beings said that they were numb to this breath.

Over the years, the movement of the breath breaking through in the deserted city has been heard continuously, as if it was deliberately telling them.

Not to mention the king of heaven, even the king of heaven above the king of heaven has appeared.

That time, almost all the forces in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm came to the Wasteland City to congratulate.

The Heavenly Monarch Realm.

An existence that cannot be seen on the surface.

Some powerful races may have it, but it will never appear in the eyes of the world.

Because that is the trump card.

But the Wasteland City will not hide it at all. Just kidding, the Lord of the Wasteland City is a terrifying existence that can kill the Heavenly Fate Realm in seconds.

Why do people still need to hide it?

In the Lord's Mansion of the Wasteland City.

Gu Chen, who had just broken through, entered the hall.

At this time, An Xing, A Wei, Yun Qi and others were all in the hall.

"Old brother, you are a little slow."

Seeing Gu Chen, Yun Qi smiled.

Hearing this, Gu Chen smiled and said nothing.

Although his talent is definitely not low among these people, he prefers to practice more steadily.

As for the speed of breakthrough, he is not slow, but others are too abnormal.

Especially An Xing, who often shamelessly comes to Lu Daosheng to ask for fate.

However, although Lu Daosheng will help An Xing break through, the consequences are also very tragic.

Adhering to the concept of polishing the foundation, after helping An Xing break through, Lu Daosheng will take An Xing to the trial he created.

It's called a trial, but it's actually a beating.

But the effect is really good. Even though An Xing's cultivation has made great progress, his foundation is still very solid.

I have to say that An Xing is too cruel.

The same is true for himself.

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

"In this case, then everyone is here."

Suddenly, everyone in the hall stood at attention and looked forward in an orderly and respectful manner.

Looking at the few people below.

These are all representatives of their deserted city's apparent combat power.

Huang Shou stood at the front, his strength had reached the Heavenly Sovereign Realm, and he seemed to be only one step away from the Heavenly Fate Realm.

Yunqi had just broken through to the Heavenly Sovereign Realm not long ago.

Next, it was Gu Chen, A Wei, An Xing and others, all of whom had reached the Heavenly King Realm.

Including Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing.

Especially Ao Qing.

When Ao Qing broke through to the Heavenly King Realm that day, at the signal of Lu Daosheng, the terrifying dragon might poured down from the inside of Huangcheng in all directions.

It shook the entire Wanling Realm.

The energy of the Heavenly King Realm Ice Dragon is very large.

For a time, countless forces envied the dragon clan.

However, not long after, a piece of news came out.

Ao Qing, who broke through to the Heavenly King Realm, had been driven out of the dragon clan a long time ago.

Suddenly, the countless envy turned into ridicule.

Everyone was paying attention to the movements of the dragon clan.

In the dragon clan, the ancestor of the dragon clan was extremely angry, and the rest of the clan members were regretting their actions.

Only the chief of the dragon clan, Ao Lie, remained silent.

In the hall, at this time, Lu Daosheng continued: "Next, the remains of the former human forces will appear in the Wanling Realm, and there will be opportunities and dangers."

Everyone was slightly stunned when they heard this.

Opportunity?

What opportunity can compare to being in the deserted city.

Seeing the trace of disdain in the eyes of everyone, Lu Daosheng's mouth twitched slightly.

After staying in his deserted city for a long time, he really has his eyes high.

Then Lu Daosheng said: "This time, all of you have to go. Remember, the main thing is not the opportunity, but the opportunity to train."

Hearing this, everyone did not dare to refuse, and immediately agreed.

"There are three forces in total, namely the Human Emperor Palace, the Heavenly Court, and the Holy Mountain. You can distribute them freely."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

And judging from the time deduced by Lu Daosheng, it is not far away.

At the same time, in the two forbidden areas of the Wanling Realm.

At the same time, a powerful aura burst out from the two forbidden areas at the same time.

Feeling these two auras, some powerful forces were shaken.

Sure enough, did the two tribes also appear?

"Lord City Lord, what is this?"

In the hall, Gu Chen and his people also felt these two auras, looking puzzled.

They had not set foot in those places in the deserted city, so they did not know much.

At this time, An Xing said: "As far as I know, there seems to be a powerful force hiding in the two forbidden areas."

Hearing this, everyone was surprised and said: "Powerful forces?"

An Xing smiled and said: "For those forces outside."

For their deserted city, it may be just so-so, but for Lu Daosheng.

Well, they are just two pieces of garbage.
